toolsPromo.text: Use Obriym Tools to resize listing photos and convert supplier data, then manage products and orders in the CRM.

item1.q: Is Obriym CRM only for sales teams?
item1.a: No. B2B teams can use the CRM pipeline, while online stores add catalog, inventory, orders and storefront sync in the same workspace.

item2.q: Can we connect an existing website or store?
item2.a: Yes. The platform provides a JS lead widget, REST API, universal webhooks and adapters for popular commerce, messaging and payment platforms.
